title: AI配置怎么摆？：核心锚定美国大盘科技，大宗商品做平衡
speaker: Jeannie

segments.en: Yeah, and I think we're moving into the part of the year, the time of the year when it's actually favorable for equity markets. How much exposure do I need to be adding more exposure than to whether that's the winners,
segments.zh: 我们正进入一年中对权益市场较为有利的阶段。我该增加多少敞口，是否要加在赢家上？

segments.en: whether that's tech, AI momentum, the earnings picture as you outline there just seems to be a no-brainer. But we're also moving into thresholds, how much exposure does one actually want and need indirectly and directly in AI, for example?
segments.zh: 无论是科技、AI动能，还是你描述的盈利图景，看起来都很明确。但也要考虑阈值，比如在AI上直接和间接到底需要多少敞口？

segments.en: Yeah, we have that as a very, very predominant and just all year, we've been getting that question from clients. For us, we do think a core anchor should be in the places where you have the greatest earnings visibility
segments.zh: 这是全年客户问得最多的问题之一。我们认为核心底仓应放在盈利可见度最高的地方。

segments.en: and that is US large cap, it's going to be anchored to technology companies that have exposure to AI. Now, that said, we actually like to balance it out with some other pieces of the marketplace that have been doing well.
segments.zh: 也就是美国大盘，锚定在那些与AI相关的科技公司上。不过，我们也喜欢用市场上其他表现不错的部分来平衡。

segments.en: There's definitely parts of the AI supply chain and that's where one person's CapEx, our head of portfolio strategy likes to say is another person's revenues, whether it's semis or even some of the industrial companies involved in AI or PowerBuild.
segments.zh: AI供应链的某些环节确实如此，我们的组合策略主管常说，一个人的资本开支就是另一个人的收入，无论是半导体，还是参与AI或电力建设的工业企业。

segments.en: The other piece that's been really interesting to us and admittedly, it's a little bit more of a volatile part of the market and has sensitivity to the Middle East is just the commodities and natural resource sector.
segments.zh: 另一个让我们很感兴趣的部分，坦白说波动更大，也对中东局势敏感，就是大宗商品和自然资源板块。

segments.en: For us, when you think about what should do well in a high inflationary but also high growth world, commodities actually do well and right now it's also benefiting on top of just kind of like a core macro picture of good demand from AI and other just CapEx demand that we're seeing
segments.zh: 在高通胀但高增长的环境里，大宗商品往往表现不错，目前它还受益于AI和其他资本开支带来的良好需求。

segments.en: but also tightness and supply and so that one's been a little bit more tactical. We've been in and out of it a couple of times but it has been a nice kind of counterbalance to the AI trade as people know it.
segments.zh: 同时还有供给偏紧，所以这个板块更偏战术性。我们进出过几次，但它对大家熟知的AI交易起到了不错的平衡作用。
